queries:
WITH j AS (
    SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm
    FROM Examination e
    INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(igm) AS m FROM j WHERE igm IS NOT NULL
),
dev AS (
    SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j.igm - overall.m AS deviation
    FROM j, overall
),
grp AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev
    FROM dev
    WHERE deviation IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.deviation
FROM dev d
INNER JOIN grp g ON d.SEX = g.SEX
WHERE d.deviation > g.avg_dev
ORDER BY (d.deviation - g.avg_dev) IS NULL, (d.deviation - g.avg_dev) DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) ORDER BY `aCL IgM` - (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) DESC;
